evals.name: adv-study
evals.prompt: Using the Quiet Strength Bible's study method, walk me through a full study of Philippians 4:6-7 on anxiety, and give related verses from the Verse Finder.
assertions: Uses the three-step method: observation, interpretation, application
Applies each step to Philippians 4:6-7 specifically
Gives related verses on fear/anxiety or prayer
Connects to Dungy's 'God's playbook' framing or the Principles/Practices/Priorities structure

evals.name: adv-work
evals.prompt: I'm starting a side business and worried about money and integrity. Build a 7-day devotional using Proverbs and the NT on work, wealth and integrity.
assertions: Uses Proverbs passages on work or wealth
Each day includes an application or reflection question
Stays faithful to scripture rather than prosperity-gospel promises
